test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2022: Official Paper (Held On: 09 March, 2023 Shift 4)
subject: general
question:
Select the correct passive form of the given sentence.

The maid washes the windows every week.

options.text: The windows are wash every week by the maid.
The windows were washed every week by the maid.
The windows are washed every week by the maid.
The windows was washed every week by the maid.

solution:
The correct passive form of the given sentence is: "The windows are washed every week by the maid." 

In the passive voice, the subject of the sentence becomes the receiver of the action, while the doer of the action is either omitted or introduced with the preposition "by". 

Here, "the windows" is the subject of the sentence, and "are washed" is the passive form of the verb "wash". The doer of the action is "the maid", which is introduced with the preposition "by". 

Option 1 is incorrect because it uses the wrong verb form ("wash" instead of "washed") and the wrong subject-verb agreement ("windows are" instead of "windows were"). 

Option 2 is incorrect because it uses the wrong verb tense ("were washed" instead of "are washed"). 

Option 4 is incorrect because it uses the wrong verb form ("was washed" instead of "are washed") and the wrong subject-verb agreement ("windows was" instead of "windows are"). 

Therefore, the correct answer is option 3: "The windows are washed every week by the maid."
